group.name: Cisco Nexus Switch Receiver
group.description: Dashboard group for SSH/NX-OS switch metrics emitted by the Cisco OS receiver, focused on Nexus reachability, interfaces, VXLAN/EVPN fabric state, vPC/LACP, optics, and hardware health.

dashboards.name: 00 Nexus Switch Health And Fabric
dashboards.description: Value: first-response dashboard for Cisco Nexus SSH/NX-OS switch telemetry, interface pressure, VXLAN/EVPN state, L2 redundancy, optics, and hardware evidence.
dashboards.value: Use this dashboard when the affected device is a Nexus switch collected over SSH. It keeps collection trust, interface symptoms, fabric control-plane state, redundancy, and optics in one page.

charts.name: Value Provided
charts.description: Value: explains how to use this Nexus switch dashboard. Interpretation: start with reachability and scrape completeness, then correlate interface, fabric, redundancy, optics, and hardware panels by device and interface.
charts.markdown:
## Value Provided
Use this page for SSH/NX-OS switch incidents. Prove collection health first, then move through link pressure, VXLAN/EVPN control-plane state, vPC/LACP/STP, optics, and hardware symptoms.

charts.name: Device Reachability
charts.description: Value: identifies Nexus switches that stopped responding to SSH collection. Interpretation: 1 means reachable, 0 means unreachable.

charts.name: Partial Scrapes
charts.description: Value: shows whether one or more NX-OS command families failed. Interpretation: 1 means the scrape was incomplete and adjacent charts may be missing evidence.

charts.name: Interface Traffic Rate
charts.description: Value: shows RX/TX bandwidth pressure by switch interface. Interpretation: sustained increases, silence, or asymmetry point to path changes or congestion.

charts.name: Interface Utilization
charts.description: Value: normalizes interface traffic by line speed. Interpretation: values near 1 indicate saturation risk.

charts.name: VXLAN NVE Peer Status
charts.description: Value: finds failed VXLAN NVE peers. Interpretation: rows below healthy state identify underlay, BGP EVPN, or VTEP reachability issues.

charts.name: EVPN Route Inventory
charts.description: Value: shows EVPN route presence by VNI and route type. Interpretation: sudden drops indicate control-plane withdrawal or collection gaps.

charts.name: vPC Status
charts.description: Value: identifies vPC domain or peer-link problems. Interpretation: unhealthy rows explain dual-homed workload or fabric edge symptoms.

charts.name: LACP Errors
charts.description: Value: highlights link aggregation control-plane errors. Interpretation: spikes by interface explain member link removal or bundle instability.

charts.name: Transceiver Sensors
charts.description: Value: tracks optical power, temperature, voltage, and laser bias. Interpretation: drift or threshold-adjacent values explain CRCs, link flaps, and optical path trouble.

charts.name: Hardware Status
charts.description: Value: surfaces fan, power, module, platform, and temperature health. Interpretation: unhealthy rows explain device instability or environmental risk.
